name: Player Rig
description: One rig per player: a nameplate and a health bar that follow every avatar, with hit points the Multiplayer Server owns. Clients render the rig; the server decides how much health anyone actually has.

changelog.notes: Initial release: per-player rig with an avatar-anchored nameplate and health bar, a right-hand anchor for held items, server-owned hit points in Storage.player, and a hitscan gun script that reports hits for the server to validate
